title: pH-driven spontaneous recovery of tyrosine via co-precipitation in the indirect aqueous carbonation of gypsum
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9335-9344
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09358A, Paper
Open Access

Yujie Qu, Yuan Gong, Baizhi Wu, Chunlei Li, Lanying Wang, Yi Wang
A pH-driven spontaneous co-precipitation strategy enables additive recovery in indirect aqueous carbonation of gypsum. The tyrosine-mediated process achieves >92% recovery and stable cycling over multiple runs.
